mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS new_followed_count FROM user_follow WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND status = 1 AND follow_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY date;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow WHERE follow_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow WHERE follow_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT uf.user_id AS followId, m.name AS username, uf.create_time AS createTime FROM user_follow uf JOIN member m ON uf.user_id = m.id WHERE uf.follow_id = #{followId} AND uf.status = 1 ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC
